purpose: Canonical relationship and function register for the historical and current AWESWELL LIMITED / Sun Rock platform. It supplements, and does not replace, legal-entity, identity, insolvency, evidence or proceeding registers.
controlling_rules: AWESWELL LIMITED is the legal UK Sponsor/HoldCo; Sun Rock is the hospitality/investment platform identity and is not automatically a legal person.

LPB, Pink Canary Services, Hava Vida, Matkator, the Communities, UK distributors, advisers and counterparties remain legally distinct; Hava Vida is nevertheless canonically within the AWESWELL LIMITED / Sun Rock business and economic perimeter.
A historical commercial relationship does not prove ownership, agency outside the contract, common knowledge, wrongdoing or present-day status.
Proposed acquisition is not completed acquisition. Signed distribution documentation is not the same thing as ownership of the distributor.
LPB's insolvency estate is not the whole mixed-ownership Sun Park hotel and is not the whole Sun Rock business/platform.
Historical legal and regulatory recitals are date-specific and do not establish current 2026 status without current verification.

historical_tracks.name: 2012 operating rescue and direct-sales origin
historical_tracks.proposition: Project-side sources describe Pink/Monterecco taking over Sun Park operation in 2012 and building direct sales while maintaining a functioning hotel platform.
sources: Notarial response 16 Jan 2018 and Jonathan Simó economic report
historical_tracks.boundary: Exact rights, unit scope, liabilities and accounting treatment remain document-specific.

historical_tracks.name: LPB / Pink hotel-operation framework
historical_tracks.proposition: The 26 Feb 2016 agreement records a hotel-operation structure, unity-of-operation framing and Pink's stated means to 'reflotar el Hotel', including management, commercialisation and administration.
sources: Google Drive: Contrato de Arremdamiento - Explotacion Hotelera Luchy-Pink Canary Services (01 Marzo 2016).pdf
historical_tracks.boundary: The later rent/default judgment and enforcement record remain mandatory contrary evidence.

historical_tracks.name: Creditor and insolvency solution
historical_tracks.proposition: Project-side and adviser records show Bankia/Haya/Sareb negotiations, related-party advice, convenio work and later Cuatrecasas analysis of conclusion through payment/consignation of all claims.
historical_tracks.boundary: Advice and planning do not prove that all required funds were unconditionally available or paid at the relevant date.

historical_tracks.name: Solos vertical distribution and acquisition programme
historical_tracks.proposition: The contemporaneous plan combined an independent UK sales/distribution relationship with a proposed acquisition of the Solos group, intended to create a vertically integrated UK customer and tour-operator channel for Sun Park.
sources: Google Drive: Solo's Holidays Investment Memorandum 111116.docx
Google Drive: Sun Rock - Solos SPA - Hamlins draft - 13.12.2016.DOCX
Google Drive: notarised Annex Agreement signed David Arnold
historical_tracks.boundary: Proposed acquisition must never be described as completed on the current evidence.

historical_tracks.name: UK regulated-sales and financial-promotion controls
historical_tracks.proposition: The source record shows ATOL/package-travel architecture in the distribution contracts and separate legal/compliance work on the planned but unlaunched Sun Rock mini-bond.
sources: Google Drive: Hava Vida Sales Agreement Final.docx
Google Drive: Draft Bond Offering Document - Legal - 20.04
historical_tracks.boundary: Historic recitals/communications do not establish current licences or approvals. The mini-bond must remain described as planned/unlaunched unless primary issuance evidence proves otherwise.

historical_tracks.name: Alternative UK distribution route
historical_tracks.proposition: The 2017 Hava Vida–Midcounties documentation evidences a separate regulated UK sales route, supporting continuity of the distribution objective beyond the proposed Solos acquisition.
sources: Google Drive: Hava Vida Sales Agreement Final.docx
Google Drive: Sales Agreement Hava Vida - MCT (27NOV2017).pdf
historical_tracks.boundary: Formation, execution, actual sales, money flows and duration require transaction evidence.

historical_tracks.name: Hotel improvement / operator / investor routes
historical_tracks.proposition: 2018 correspondence with Meliá shows continued work on refurbishment, category upgrade, operator interest and possible investor/new-owner routes.
sources: Gmail Meliá / Jordi Sanchís correspondence Feb–Mar 2018
historical_tracks.boundary: Interest and diligence are not completed management, investment or acquisition commitments.

evidential_objective.primary: Test whether the contemporaneous record supports a sustained whole-hotel preservation, refloat, commercialisation, financing and LPB-creditor-exit programme rather than a project-side objective to worsen LPB or Sun Park.
evidential_objective.criminal_first_boundary: Where deliberate obstruction or sabotage is alleged, require actor-specific proof of knowledge, capacity, warning, decision, lawful alternative, effect, causation and beneficiary; do not infer criminal intent from adverse outcome alone.
evidential_objective.recovery_boundary: Attribute every asset, right, income stream, loss and remedy to the correct legal holder and avoid double counting across LPB, Pink, Hava Vida, Aweswell, Matkator, Communities and third parties.

priority_gap.question: Reconcile hotel booking → customer/Solos receipt → distributor commission → operator entitlement → operating expenditure → LPB entitlement → escrow/acquisition funding.
priority_gap.reason: This is the principal red-team bridge needed to distinguish legitimate operating/distribution/acquisition architecture from any alleged diversion of LPB value.
